title: Cartan--Leray descent for a procyclic tower of finite etale torsors
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, put $A=\mathbf F_\ell$, and let $V$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For every $r\ge0$ let $p_r:V_r\to V$ be a finite etale torsor under the constant cyclic group $G_r=\mathbf Z/\ell^r\mathbf Z$: this means $p_r$ is finite, etale and surjective and the action map $V_r\times G_r\to V_r\times_VV_r$, $(v,g)\mapsto(v,g v)$, is an isomorphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-surjective-morphism, def-pc-fibre-product]. Suppose $V_0=V$ and given $G_{r+1}\to G_r$-equivariant transition maps $V_{r+1}\to V_r$ over $V$, compatible with reduction modulo $\ell^r$. Set $G=\varprojlim_rG_r=\mathbf Z_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers] and $M^q=\varinjlim_rH^q(V_r,A)$, with pullback transition maps and the induced discrete continuous $G$-action. Cohomology on schemes is ordinary small-etale cohomology of the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and group cohomology is [def-exc-continuous-cohomology]. There is a natural first-quadrant spectral sequence
$$E_2^{a,b}=H^a_{\mathrm{cont}}(G,M^b)\Longrightarrow H^{a+b}(V,A).$$
If the constant-section maps identify every $H^0(V_r,A)$ with $A$ and $M^q=0$ for $q>0$, the edge maps are isomorphisms $H^a_{\mathrm{cont}}(G,A)\simeq H^a(V,A)$. In degree zero the edge is the constant-section map. In degree one the character $G\to G_1=A$, $g\mapsto g\bmod\ell$, maps to the class of the $A$-torsor $V_1\to V$ under the given action.
